name: heisenberg/heisenberg
description: A block-based content engine and bilingual blog backend for Laravel.

suggest.spatie/laravel-activitylog: Wire the AuditSink to Spatie activitylog (optional).
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: If the host uses Spatie roles, the default RoleGate maps to it.
suggest.mallardduck/blade-lucide-icons: Optional Lucide-backed IconProvider; the default provider serves the bundled Phosphor set (resources/icons/phosphor).
suggest.intervention/image: Generate responsive image variants (small/medium) for the media library on upload; without it, uploads still work but ship no variants. Require ^3.9 — v4 changed the ImageManager API and is NOT compatible.
